why_it_matters: Without them, leakage between files of one recording session cannot be ruled out and variance cannot be partitioned
what_would_close_it: A metadata CSV giving session_id and replicate_id per file

why_it_matters: Detected events are threshold crossings, not verified trapping events; sensitivity and specificity of detection are unknown
what_would_close_it: A manually annotated subset of files, even 10 per class

why_it_matters: Novelty detection cannot be evaluated, only diagnosed by leave-one-class-out
what_would_close_it: Recordings of a third condition, or buffer-only controls

why_it_matters: Batch effects cannot be modelled or removed, and units cannot be converted to physical current
what_would_close_it: Per-file acquisition date, amplifier gain, and a calibration factor

why_it_matters: Cross-validated numbers on this pool cannot confirm performance on new recordings
